posts.text: Feels like the surge charges, lack of availability, etc. has just destroyed Uber and Lyft. Anytime I’m arriving at airports or train stations now, I’ve found myself using taxi cabs again. They’re always right there, usually cheaper, and often a much more pleasant experience.

If it’s so easy to take the Strait, why don’t we take it? If we have so much oil, more than we ever need, why are gas prices so high? If all our goals are essentially achieved, why do we need another 2-3 weeks of bombing? Saying nothing of the war crime threats, just nonsensical.
Democrats absolutely roll over again. Literal clockwork. Trump and Rs can always bank on it
Now Iran says Trump's claims of a ceasefire deal are false, that it has full control of Hormuz, and it has continued to fire missiles at allies in the region.
It's just incoherent. Yesterday, Strait of Hormuz being closed was not our problem, but Europe's. Today, the Strait must be open for a ceasefire deal to hold.

This massive account, constantly boosted on X, Matt Van Swol, is a total grift. He claims to be a Democrat turned Republican, "radicalized" (originally) by all manner of events from 2022-2025, but has been a Trump guy since at least 2015. It's all just totally made up.




Joshua Reed Eakle 🗽 (@JoshEakle)
